title: GitLab CI: Bring our macOS builds more in line with each other
description:
Use aqtinstall to install Qt. Use a common Python venv location.

Lowercase our file hashes on Windows.

(cherry picked from commit 452efca2b85f70797056ef967a859cb10bfcb485)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

@@ -235,7 +235,7 @@ workflow:
     - printf "\e[0Ksection_end:%s:ci_env_section\r\e[0K" "$(date +%s)"
     - brew --version
     - printf "\e[0Ksection_start:%s:brew_section[collapsed=true]\r\e[0KInstalling prerequisites" "$( date +%s)"
-    - brew install ccache cmake ninja qt6
